input.body:
# Feature Spec: Krotal Scanner (Crotal OCR via PWA Camera)

## Overview

Camera-based crotal (ear tag) scanner using the PWA device camera to read animal identification codes. The farmer points their phone at an ear tag, the system reads the code (ES + 13 digits), and returns the animal's information.

For the demo: **real camera access via PWA**, with **simulated OCR processing** — the recognition logic is mocked but the camera UX is real.

---

## Demo Scope

| Aspect | Approach |
|--------|----------|
| Camera access | Real — PWA MediaDevices API (getUserMedia) |
| OCR processing | Mocked — simulates recognition after 1-2 seconds |
| Animal lookup | Real — queries local DB by crotal code |
| Manual input | Real — fallback text input if camera fails |

---

## How the Mock OCR Works

1. Open the real camera (rear-facing, with flash toggle)
2. Show scanning overlay (viewfinder rectangle + scanning animation)
3. After 2 seconds: randomly pick one seeded animal crotal from the DB
4. Display result as if recognized
5. Allow manual input as alternative

---

## User Flow

### Entry Points
1. Standalone: Main navigation → "Escanear Crotal"
2. From wizard: Step 2 of Comunicar Nacimiento → returns identified animal

### Screens

**Screen 1 — Camera Viewfinder**: Full-screen camera, scanning overlay, flash toggle, manual input button

**Screen 2 — Animal Result Card**: Crotal code, species, breed, sex, birth date, name, sub-exploitation, status + actions

**Screen 3 — Error/Tips**: Recognition failed message + tips (clean crotal, 10-15cm distance, good light, steady phone) + retry/manual

**Screen 4 — Manual Input**: Formatted crotal code input (auto-prefix ES) + search button

**Screen 5 — Permission Denied**: Camera permission instructions per OS + manual fallback

---

## Technical Implementation

### Camera (PWA)
```
navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
    video: { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720 } }
});
```
Flash toggle via `track.applyConstraints({ advanced: [{ torch: true }] })`.

### Backend
- `KrotalScannerController`
- `GET /scanner` → scanner page
- `GET /api/animals/by-crotal/{code}` → JSON lookup
- `GET /api/animals/random-crotal` → for mock OCR

### Frontend
- `pages/scanner/index.tsx`
- Components: `CameraViewfinder.tsx`, `ScannerOverlay.tsx`, `AnimalResultCard.tsx`, `ManualCrotalInput.tsx`

### Integration with Wizard
Scanner can be invoked from birth wizard Step 2. Modal/sheet approach preferred for seamless UX.

---

## UI/UX Guidelines

- Full screen immersive camera (no header/nav)
- Dark UI for outdoor visibility
- Large buttons for gloved hands
- Haptic vibration on successful recognition

# Feature Spec: Regulations Screen (Anticipación Normativa)

## Overview

Dashboard screen showing proactive alerts, upcoming deadlines, and regulatory notifications. The "anticipation engine" of NekazarIA — surfaces actionable information before the farmer has to look for it.

For the demo: **fully mocked alerts**, seeded in the DB, presented in a realistic UI.

---

## Demo Scope

| Aspect | Approach |
|--------|----------|
| Alert data | Seeded — pre-created alerts in DB |
| Rule engine | Not implemented — static data |
| Notifications | Not implemented — in-app display only |
| Actions | Navigation links to relevant pages |

---

## Data Model

### `Regulation`
Fields: exploitation_id, type (enum), severity (info/warning/urgent), title, description, action_label, action_url, due_date, is_read, is_resolved, metadata (json)

### Alert Types
- `sanitary_campaign` — Active campaign with pending animals (warning)
- `animal_immobilized` — Animal blocked due to sanitary issue (urgent)
- `birth_deadline` — Pending birth registrations within legal deadline (warning)
- `census_reminder` — Annual census declaration reminder (info)
- `subsidy_open` — Relevant grant/subsidy open (info)
- `movement_pending` — Movement guide pending validation (warning)
- `document_expiring` — Certificate about to expire (warning)
- `capacity_warning` — Approaching max capacity (info)

### Sanitary Campaign Detail
`SanitaryCampaign` model + `CampaignAnimal` pivot with status (pending/sampled/immobilized)

---

## Seeded Demo Data (8-10 alerts)

1. URGENT: 2 animales inmovilizados por campaña BVD 2026
2. WARNING: Campaña BVD termina 10/06, 5 animales pendientes
3. WARNING: 3 nacimientos pendientes antes del 25/03
4. WARNING: Guía de movimiento pendiente de validación
5. INFO: Convocatoria ayudas ganadería ecológica 2026
6. INFO: Censo anual pendiente subexplotación avícola
7. WARNING: Libro de establo caduca 15/04/2026
8. INFO: Subexplotación bovina al 90% capacidad (45/50)

---

## Screens

### Main Screen (`/normativa`)
- Summary badges (urgent/warning/info counts)
- Filter tabs: Todas | Pendientes | Resueltas
- Alert cards with severity badge, title, description, action CTA, due date, read indicator
- Empty state when all resolved

### Campaign Detail (`/normativa/campanas/{id}`)
- Campaign name, status badge, progress bar
- Lists: pendientes, muestreados, inmovilizados
- Each with animal cards + actions

---

## Technical Implementation

### Backend
- `RegulationController` (index, show)
- `SanitaryCampaignController` (show)
- API endpoints for mark-as-read and mark-as-resolved

### Frontend
- `pages/normativa/index.tsx`
- `pages/normativa/campanas/show.tsx`
- Components: `AlertCard`, `SeverityBadge`, `AlertFilters`, `CampaignProgress`

---

## UI/UX Guidelines

- Color system: Red (#EF4444) urgent, Yellow (#F59E0B) warning, Blue (#3B82F6) info
- WhatsApp-familiar card style
- Simple language: "Tienes 2 animales bloqueados" not "2 registros con estado INMOVILIZADO"
- Badge count on navigation item
- Dashboard widget with latest alerts summary

input.name: NekazarIA — Demo Spec: AI Chatbot
input.body:
# Feature Spec: AI Chatbot (Agente NekazarIA)

## Overview

Conversational assistant embedded in the app. Helps farmers understand exploitation data, navigate regulations, and get guidance on procedures — in simple, jargon-free Spanish. WhatsApp-like interface.

For the demo: **mocked AI responses** using keyword-matching + template system. No real LLM, but UI is production-ready.

---

## Demo Scope

| Aspect | Approach |
|--------|----------|
| AI/LLM | Mocked — predefined response patterns |
| Conversation UI | Real — WhatsApp-style chat |
| Data context | Real — responses reference seeded DB data |
| Conversation history | Persisted in DB per user |

---

## Mock Response Strategy

Keyword-matching + template system enriched with real DB data:

| Keywords | Response |
|----------|----------|
| animales, cuantos, tengo | "Tienes {count} animales..." |
| bloqueado, inmovilizado | "Tienes {count} animales inmovilizados por {campaign}..." |
| nacimiento, registrar, cría | "Para comunicar un nacimiento..." + guide |
| movimiento, guía, trasladar | "Para mover animales necesitas una guía..." |
| campaña, sanitaria, BVD | Campaign status with progress |
| ayuda, help | General help with quick replies |
| hola, buenos días | Greeting with farmer's name |
| _default_ | "No he entendido del todo..." + suggestions |

Templates enriched with real data: animal counts, campaign progress, farmer name, etc.

---

## Data Model

### `ChatConversation`
Fields: user_id, started_at, last_message_at

### `ChatMessage`
Fields: conversation_id, role (user/assistant), content, quick_replies (json), metadata (json)

---

## Screen Layout (`/chat`)

### WhatsApp-style interface
- Header: NekazarIA avatar, title "NekazarIA Laguntzailea", online status
- Message area: Bubbles (user right, assistant left), timestamps, typing indicator
- Quick reply chips: Horizontal scrollable below last assistant message
- Input area: Text input + send button + camera shortcut

### "Explícamelo Fácil" Global FAB
Floating button on ALL pages. Context-aware:
- On exploitation panel → "Explícame mi explotación"
- On animal detail → "Explícame la ficha de este animal"
- On regulations → "Explícame esta alerta"
- On wizard → "No entiendo este paso"

---

## Technical Implementation

### Backend
- `ChatController` (index, store)
- `ChatbotService` — keyword matching, template rendering, DB data enrichment
- Models: `ChatConversation`, `ChatMessage`

### Frontend
- `pages/chat/index.tsx`
- Components: `ChatBubble`, `QuickReplyChips`, `TypingIndicator`, `ChatInput`, `ExplainButton` (global FAB)
- Simulated typing delay (0.5-1.5s)
- Auto-scroll to bottom on new messages

---

## Demo Scripted Walkthrough

1. Farmer: "Hola"
2. Bot: "¡Hola Aitor! ¿En qué puedo ayudarte hoy?" + quick replies
3. Farmer taps: "Mis alertas"
4. Bot: "Tienes 3 alertas pendientes: 1 urgente y 2 de atención..."
5. Farmer taps: "Sí, explícame"
6. Bot: Explains immobilized animals in simple language
7. Farmer taps: "Ver animales bloqueados"
8. Bot: Shows details + link to campaign page

---

## UI/UX Guidelines

- WhatsApp-familiar, not corporate chatbot widget
- Simple language: "Tus vacas" not "bovinos en subexplotación"
- Quick replies are primary interaction (most farmers won't type)
- Typing delay makes it feel natural
- Friendly, non-robotic avatar

---
name: NekazarIA Demo Context
description: NekazarIA is a GovTech project for Diputación Foral de Bizkaia — livestock management PWA demo with mocked features for presentation
type: project
---

NekazarIA is a GovTech pilot project for the Diputación Foral de Bizkaia (agriculture department). It helps livestock farmers manage their exploitations, animals, and regulatory compliance.

**Why:** The Diputación wants to reduce farmer dependency on physical Gertu offices and SEDE web portal. Target users are elderly farmers with low digital literacy who primarily use mobile phones.

**How to apply:** This demo repo (nekarzaria-demo) is a Laravel + Inertia + React PWA built to present 4 core features to the Diputación. All features are heavily mocked — no real MUGIDE/SEDE/Giltza integration. The actual production app will be Expo (React Native).
